import subprocess, time, os, sys, select
cmd=['qemu-system-riscv64','-machine','virt','-bios','none','-kernel','kernel/kernel','-m','128M','-smp','3','-nographic','-monitor','none','-serial','stdio','-global','virtio-mmio.force-legacy=false','-drive','file=fs.img,if=none,format=raw,id=x0','-device','virtio-blk-device,drive=x0,bus=virtio-mmio-bus.0']
p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
buf=b''
def pump(t):
    global buf
    end=time.time()+t
    while time.time()<end:
        r,_,_=select.select([p.stdout],[],[],0.5)
        if r:
            d=os.read(p.stdout.fileno(),4096)
            if not d: break
            buf+=d
def wait_for(s,t):
    end=time.time()+t
    while time.time()<end:
        if s in buf: return True
        pump(1)
    return False
wait_for(b'$ ',25)
p.stdin.write(b'kalloctest\n'); p.stdin.flush()
ok=wait_for(b'test2 OK',120)
print('===TEST2_OK=%s===' % ok)
print('===SERIAL_TAIL===')
print(buf.decode('utf-8','replace')[-4000:])
p.kill()

cmd=['qemu-system-riscv64','-machine','virt','-bios','none','-kernel','kernel/kernel','-m','128M','-smp','3','-nographic','-monitor','none','-serial','stdio','-global','virtio-mmio.force-legacy=false','-drive','file=fs.img,if=none,format=raw,id=x0','-device','virtio-blk-device,drive=x0,bus=virtio-mmio-bus.0']
p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
buf=b''
def pump(t):
    global buf
    end=time.time()+t
    while time.time()<end:
        r,_,_=select.select([p.stdout],[],[],0.3)
        if r:
            d=os.read(p.stdout.fileno(),4096)
            if not d: return
            buf+=d; log.write(d); log.flush()
def wait_for(s,t):
    end=time.time()+t
    while time.time()<end:
        if s in buf: return True
        pump(0.5)
    return False
print('PROMPT=%s'%wait_for(b'$ ',25))
p.stdin.write(b'kalloctest\n'); p.stdin.flush()
started=wait_for(b'start test2',20)
print('STARTED=%s'%started)
base=buf.count(b'.')
for i in range(8):
    pump(10)
    print('DOTS=%d t=%.0f tail=%r'%(buf.count(b'.')-base, time.time(), buf.decode('utf-8','replace')[-160:]))
print('===TAIL===')
print(buf.decode('utf-8','replace')[-2500:])
p.kill()
